summary: The tutorial covers how to use notes in Microsoft PowerPoint for presentations. Notes serve two purposes: providing additional content or references for speakers and offering notes for the audience when presenting slides. To add notes, open a presentation file, select a slide, and click on the notes tab where you can type notes that appear below the slide. Notes can be formatted by changing the font type and size, adding bullet points, and customizing the appearance. A notes master can be created to standardize the format across all slides. Notes placeholders can be resized to fit more text. The tutorial also demonstrates how to add logos and shapes to notes, such as triangles, and customize their appearance. Overall, the tutorial teaches how to effectively utilize notes in PowerPoint for both speakers and audiences.
